environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no additional request inspection. The application is directly internet-facing on port 8080. DNS for app.company.example.com points to this NLB. No additional WAF or request filtering is configured. The OAuth provider does not enforce strict redirect_uri matching (accepts any URI passed by the client application).

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
